name: Cory’s Pale Ale — sample
source: Illustrative personal recipe; review before brewing.

steps.title: Heat strike water
steps.instructions: Heat the planned strike-water volume. Verify the recipe’s water calculation, then confirm when ready to transfer.

steps.title: Transfer strike water and add grain
steps.instructions: Transfer water to the mash tun, add the grain bill, and stir thoroughly. Confirm the actual mash-in.

steps.title: Hold mash temperature
steps.instructions: Hold near the mash target. No HERMS route is assumed; check temperature and manage the mash manually.

steps.title: Sparge and collect wort
steps.instructions: Follow your chosen hose routing and sparge plan. Collect the reviewed pre-boil target volume; record actual volume and gravity.

steps.title: Confirm rolling boil
steps.instructions: Confirm a rolling boil before starting the 60-minute clock. Perform the hop additions while this timer runs.

steps.title: Add bittering hops
steps.instructions: Add 1 oz Cascade at the start of the boil, then confirm the addition.

steps.title: Add late hops and Irish moss
steps.instructions: With 15 minutes remaining, add 0.5 oz Cascade and 1 tsp Irish moss. Confirm both additions.

steps.title: Chill wort
steps.instructions: Turn off propane. Use the immersion chiller to reach the yeast’s pitching target. Confirm actual temperature before moving on.

steps.title: Transfer, measure gravity, and pitch yeast
steps.instructions: Transfer to the fermenter, record volume and original gravity, and pitch yeast according to its instructions. This completes brew day; fermentation and tastings remain in the batch record.
